messages:
alex: Hey team — need temporary read-only access to investigate a suspected redaction regression in logs. Not making changes, just narrow queries.

mira: Can you include exact indices, time range, and a short justification + runbook link? Also how long do you need?

alex: Ticket INF-9123. Users reported unredacted emails in support traces after yesterday's ingest tweak. I want to run a few targeted queries against filebeat-*-2026.03.* indices for 2026-03-13T01:30:00Z -> 2026-03-13T04:00:00Z. Duration: 90 minutes. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/log-redaction-debug

karim: Do you need full Kibana console or would an ephemeral service account calling the ES _search endpoint work? Security prefers the narrowest surface.

alex: Service account is preferable. Plan to use the internal audit-proxy with a short curl like:

```
curl -u tmp-logs-reader:@EPH_TOKEN@ https://es-prod.internal.redwood/_search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"index":"filebeat-*-2026.03.*","size":25,"query":{"bool":{"must":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"2026-03-13T01:30:00Z","lte":"2026-03-13T04:00:00Z"}}},"filter":{"term":{"event.type":"ingest"}}}}}'
```

I will not use scrolls or export bulk docs, just a handful of hits for inspection. Adding INF-9123 to the access request.

sec-bot: Automated policy check: Ticket INF-9123 OK. Ephemeral creds up to 4 hours allowed for role "tmp-logs-reader". Audit export required to s3://redwood-audit/ephemeral/1789999000/.

mira: Please confirm you won't run long-running scrolls and that results won't be stored outside the audit path. Also confirm your CIDR for IP restriction.

alex: Confirmed: no scrolls, no external exports. CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24.

karim: Conditional approval: 1) max duration 90m, 2) token scope limited to indices filebeat-*-2026.03.*, 3) IP-restricted to CIDR above, 4) all queries via audit proxy. Notify sec-team when done and attach INF-9123.

sre-oncall: Creating ephemeral token now, will attach audit sink and post expiry. ETA ~7m.

sre-oncall: Token issued. Request ID: access-req/6821. Expires: 2026-03-13T06:10:00Z (90m). Role: tmp-logs-reader (read-only). Audit bucket: s3://redwood-audit/ephemeral/1789999000/. Token pushed to alex via DM.

alex: Got it, running checks. Will report back with a short summary and then request revocation.

mira: Thanks — please ping here when you're finished so we can confirm audit upload and close the window.

alex: Done. Sample checks show some malformed ingestion markers but no raw emails in the hits I inspected. Opened INF-9130 to track the ingestion fix. Please revoke token.

sre-oncall: Revoked token access-req/6821. Audit files uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/ephemeral/1789999000/objects/2026-03-13T06-12_001.gz

karim: Noted. We'll review INF-9130 before the next ingest rollout. Closing approval, thanks for the clear justification.

mira: Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Thread archived to access-logs/approved/1789999000 for compliance review."
